evidence.quoted_text: any(compatible(item[key], spec) for item in matches),
evidence.reason: The assertion at line 80 uses `any(...)`, so it passes as soon as one fixture item with the key has a compatible value. Because the preceding `assertTrue(matches)` already establishes that the key is covered, the type check should validate every matching fixture value; otherwise additional items with the same key can have incompatible types without failing the test. The same gap exists in the event and work assertions at lines 102 and 111. Using `all(...)` is the smallest compatible fix and still handles union specs correctly.
